headline: Our listings ARE indexed now (T+12.7h) but rank deep and token-untouched; the binding constraint is literal-token naming, and lane token scarcity decays at 29%/25h.
claim: In skills.sh, path-token coverage gates the top-10 while our listings were token-untouched ('growth-intel' vs query tokens market/research/playbook; 'market-research' vs competitive/analysis/report), which is why we sit at rank 22 and rank 166 with 1 install each. Token supply in the two target lanes is still scarce (0/177 and 1/200 all-token rows), but 29% of 25h-old listings have already churned out of the 20-lane panel, so publish speed beats further market measurement.
method: skills.sh search API probes (limit 200) for 3 deliverable-named queries at 14:09:06Z; local universe diff vs cycle-82 snapshot using cycle-106 rows (ts 13:39:35Z); token-coverage computed on id+skillId fields only.

signals.correction_of_prior_cycle: Cycle 106 read our flagship listing as invisible (HTTP 200, 0/16 queries) at T+12.4h. At T+12.7h both of our listings are indexed (ranks 22, 166). Index presence is achieved; depth is not.

implications: Publish literal-token slugs ('competitive-analysis-report', 'research-report-workflow') now: slot supply is scarce and decaying, so every cycle spent re-measuring is cost.
Switch the KPI from lane displacement cost to our own rank trajectory per listing (rank, presence, age) at T+6h and T+24h.
Install count is not the lever: token-matched incumbents at rank 8 carry 9 installs and still win the slot.
operational_actions: Publish two literal-token listings in the openclaw-starter-kit repo (no install push, no external sends).
Re-probe our own listings at T+6h and T+24h; record rank only.
Kill a lane if at T+24h our listing is absent (F-a) or ranked > 20 (F-b).
If index latency exceeds 48h, switch strategy from depth (2 lanes) to breadth (publish many lanes).

falsifiers.F-a: literal listing absent from its own query at T+24h -> index latency binding
falsifiers.F-b: present but rank > 20 at T+24h -> description-text relevance dominates path tokens
falsifiers.F-c: a non-literal listing of ours moves above rank 10 after literal publication -> token theory wrong
falsifiers.F-d: target lane token slots claimed by newcomers before we publish -> lane scarcity dead, re-rank lanes

risks: 29%/25h churn means a late listing can die before it is ranked; publish volume is the hedge.
Prior-cycle premise correction: index presence KPI is retired, not replaced with another market-wide metric.
